item.title: Everything You Need to Know About the Unidos Por Los Nuestros Benefit Concert: Donations, Artists & How to Watch
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our show, where music meets mission. Today, we're talking about a powerful benefit concert that's bringing together over 30 international artists to support the victims of the devastating earthquakes in Colombia and Venezuela. The event is called Unidos por los Nuestros, and it's happening this Sunday at 6 p.m. ET at the Kaseya Center in Miami.
[Soft music continues in the background]
Host: "I recently spoke with Felipe Pimiento, one of the co-founders of the initiative, along with Marc Anthony and Henry Cárdenas. Felipe shared with me how the idea for this benefit event came about. 'We had recently formed a partnership with Univision, and as soon as we landed in Colombia, I called Ignacio Meyer, the president of Univision Networks Group. We started talking about what had happened and the interest in doing something to help the people.'"
[Short clip of music from one of the participating artists plays]
Host: "The night of solidarity, unity, and hope will feature an incredible lineup of artists, including Marc Anthony, Luis Fonsi, Chayanne, and Ricardo Montaner, to name a few. The goal is to raise funds for key programs such as food assistance, healthcare, shelters, and education. The event is being led by CMN, Maestro Cares Foundation, TelevisaUnivision, and PIMIENTO Entertainment, with the support of iHeartRadio, Spotify, and other major partners.
[Soft music continues]
Host: "So, how can you support this amazing cause? You can get tickets to the event, watch it on television, or livestream it. All the details are available online. The main goal is to mobilize the global Hispanic community to support the victims of the earthquakes in Venezuela and Colombia. Let's come together to make a difference. Tune in this Sunday to Unidos por los Nuestros and be a part of this incredible effort."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for listening, and we'll see you next time on our show."
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
